admission.justification: A retained page that cannot be reopened without a model, or that silently adopts a new comparison, defeats the durability the developer asked for.

applicability: Every retained explanation revision and every staleness answer the review page shows.
conditions: A part ID satisfies the shared grammar and is not the reserved whole-page ID.
A claim belongs to one part and every claim of a mapped revision belongs to a part.
A part is stale when one of its claims’ bases moved.
A store caller can supply separate revision limits. The default explainer has no per-revision file or byte ceiling.
exclusions: A revision stored before part maps, which is answered whole-page.
The store's own FrameStaleness, which remains the whole-page answer and names the changed sides.

evidence: A5-verdict.md; A5-fixed-list-verification.md; A5-checks-complete/; prior A4 full-criterion account retained

statement: A retained revision carries its admitted part map. Staleness names affected parts and the reasons their claim bases moved, with a whole-page answer when the revision has no usable part map or a stale claim belongs to no part. The task-wide byte cap governs default explainer publication. A retained revision leaves the store only through the developer’s removal control.
